preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have compromised the owner's private key)
Attacker must hold some MemeFarm tokens to execute trades

exploit_hint: As owner, call setMarketinWalleAddress() to set the marketing wallet to attacker's address. Then manipulate tax settings via setBuyTaxes()/setAllTaxes() to set high sell taxes (e.g., 99%). Force swapAndLiquify to trigger fee distribution, sending BNB to the attacker-controlled marketing wallet. Alternatively, use changeRouterVeslon() to mint massive tokens to attacker address if ________ is compromised.
